details: The United States has unveiled an expansion of sanctions against Iran, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent describing it as an "economic D-Day" aimed at cutting off Iran's economic lifeline. Iran has dismissed the measures as desperate, but its currency, the rial, has fallen to a record low against the dollar. The move is also contributing to higher global oil prices and increased geopolitical uncertainty.
title: US Escalates Sanctions on Iran, Rial Hits Record Low

details: Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada have collapsed, leading to an escalation of their trade dispute. The US has imposed 50% tariffs on approximately $20 billion of Canadian imports, including cars, trucks, and steel. Canada has pledged to implement dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs starting September 8.
title: US-Canada Trade War Intensifies with New Tariffs

details: Bitcoin surged over 20% in the past week, surpassing $77,000, fueled by positive regulatory momentum in the US and supportive comments from President Trump regarding Bitcoin accumulation and the broader digital asset industry. The rally was also supported by strong inflows into Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).
title: Bitcoin Rallies Above $77,000 Amid Positive US Regulatory Signals

details: Global financial markets are closely watching the upcoming Jackson Hole Economic Symposium and the release of July PCE (Personal Consumption Expenditures) data for the US. Investors remain concerned about persistent inflation and rising bond yields, which could influence the Federal Reserve's monetary policy stance, with potential implications for interest rates.
title: Global Markets Eye Jackson Hole Symposium Amid Inflation Concerns
